Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original raster terrain background for a historical isometric city-building strategy game.
Primary request: one landscape 3:2 image, requested 1536 by 1024 pixels. An EMPTY lush green medieval river-valley clearing viewed in consistent classic 2:1 isometric projection, from a 45-degree compass angle looking down. Earthy hand-painted late-1990s/early-2000s historical strategy-game aesthetic, crisp readable terrain details at game scale, original artwork.
Composition: The central 80 percent is a broad level open grassy and lightly earthy clearing, continuous walkable terrain, leaving ample clean space for a functional 4 by 4 building layout to be overlaid later. Gentle old dirt roads enter from the lower and side edges and lead into the clearing. River confined to the outer upper/right edge with stone and reeds on its bank. Small woodland clusters, stones and low hills only at the far edges. The central play area should occupy most of the frame and feel close, useful as an actual game board background.
Materials and palette: muted lush olive and moss greens, warm dirt browns, desaturated river blue, textured but restrained painterly brushwork, gentle late-afternoon light from upper left.
Constraints: absolutely NO buildings anywhere in the central 80 percent, no settlements, no central landmarks, no people, no units, no towers. NO interface, NO text, NO labels, NO watermark, NO border, NO visible grid or construction-slot outlines. Do not render a game screenshot. Avoid dramatic horizon, perspective vanishing points, empty sky, and photorealism.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original transparent PNG sprite atlas for a historical isometric strategy city-building game.
Primary request: EXACTLY 20 separate detached building sprites arranged on an exact 5-COLUMN by 4-ROW uniform atlas, requested 2000 by 1600 pixels, with square 400 by 400 pixel cells. The whole background must be genuinely TRANSPARENT with alpha. If transparency cannot be provided, use perfectly uniform solid white. No checkerboard drawn into the image. All icons are centered within their own equal square cell, occupy about 72 percent of the cell, and have generous empty padding. Nothing may overlap another cell. No cell borders or grid lines.
Style: consistent original earthy painterly late-1990s/early-2000s historical strategy-game artwork, classic 2:1 isometric projection, 45-degree compass angle looking down. Crisp small-scale architectural details. Same camera and upper-left soft lighting for every sprite. Warm stone, textured timber, clay roofs, small subtle ground footprints and contact shadows. Each sprite has an isolated compact footprint and is fully visible.
EXACT row-major layout left to right:
ROW 1 (five sprites): 1 medieval town HALL with stone entry and modest wood roof; 2 FARM with small thatched hut and compact golden wheat patch; 3 LUMBERMILL with timber saw shed and log pile; 4 QUARRY with pale rock extraction pit and stone blocks; 5 GOLDMINE with dark mine entrance, gold ore and wooden support.
ROW 2 (five sprites): 6 HOUSE, small timber cottage; 7 WAREHOUSE, broad storehouse and crates; 8 BARRACKS, military stone-and-timber dormitory with red cloth flag; 9 ARCHERY RANGE, fenced practice yard and round archery targets; 10 STABLE, long horse shelter with hay and one small horse.
ROW 3 (five sprites): 11 SIEGE WORKSHOP, timber workshop with an unfinished wooden catapult; 12 ACADEMY, scholarly stone hall with tiled roof; 13 MARKET, colorful modest covered merchant stalls; 14 WALL SEGMENT, straight short stone wall with crenellations, no tower; 15 CHINESE CIVIC HALL, tiny distinctive Chinese hall with curved tiled roof.
ROW 4 (five sprites): 16 BYZANTINE CIVIC HALL with domed roof; 17 FRANKISH STONE KEEP, compact square stone keep; 18 BRITISH MANOR, timber-and-stone gabled manor; 19 JAPANESE CIVIC HALL with restrained Japanese tiled roof; 20 MONGOL YURT, compact round felt yurt.
Constraints: exactly these twenty assets, exactly five columns and four rows, equal spacing, no extra sprites, no merged structures, no perspective scene, NO text or numbers or labels, NO UI, NO border, NO watermark. Every asset must have actual empty separation from neighboring sprites. This is an atlas for later programmatic slicing.

Use case: historical-scene
Asset type: original wide battle-report illustration for a medieval historical strategy game.
Primary request: one wide landscape river-valley siege illustration, requested 1536 by 768 pixels. Original restrained historical painterly game art, earthy palette and softly weathered hand-painted texture consistent with a classic isometric medieval city-building strategy game.
Scene: a winding river through a lush green valley beside a small fortified stone town under siege, modest troop formations on grassy banks, wooden siege engines and cloth banners, forested hills framing the distant valley. Grounded scale and period materials. Views of stone walls, pitched timber roofs, river banks and organized army camps create a readable sense of strategy and geography. No specific real war or identifiable real person.
Composition: wide elevated three-quarter view, central river bend leads the eye toward the besieged town, banners and wooden siege machinery provide foreground detail. Restrained atmospheric depth, warm stone and muted greens with small dark-red and ochre banner accents. Gentle light from upper left. Detailed enough to feel like a historical game battle report yet quiet enough to support adjacent interface text.
Constraints: no text, no UI, no labels, no frame, no watermark, no logos, no modern objects, no fantasy monsters, no gore or graphic injury. No copied or borrowed game artwork. Return one illustration only.
